dedupe_keys.name: tropical cyclone winston 2016 wind damage dataset for buildings in fiji

description: This dataset gives empirical wind damage observations for buildings in Fiji after Category 5 Tropical Cyclone Winston, which made landfall on 20 February 2016 and damaged over 30,000 buildings. It was published on Zenodo on 10 December 2024 (version 1.0) by Ryan Paulik of the National Institute of Water and Atmospheric Research, Shaun Williams, Misaeli Funaki of the Fiji Meteorological Service and Richard Turner. Over 700 building-specific records from a four-day field survey in March 2016 give hazard, building and damage variables, including physical damage to structure, contents, stock, equipment and plant, and disruption to residential habitability and non-residential services. Coverage: surveyed buildings in Fiji. Access: one CSV on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: a survey sample, not a full damage census. Simulation uses: tropical cyclone wind vulnerability functions for Pacific building types and loss of function estimates. Related records: the multi-event tsunami building sample and First Street risk data.
